# RectorSeal

> > RectorSeal manufactures professional-grade HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and firestop products including Fortress Lineset Covers, Dust Free air filtration systems, and Metacaulk firestop solutions.

RectorSeal is a leading manufacturer of specialty chemical and accessory products for the HVAC/R, plumbing, and electrical trades. The company offers comprehensive product lines including indoor air quality systems, condensate management, surge protection, pipe joining solutions, and FM-approved firestop materials for commercial and residential applications.

## Key Topics

- Fortress Lineset Covers - UV-resistant PVC covers for HVAC linesets
- Dust Free Media Air Cleaners - HEPA filtration systems for indoor air quality
- Metacaulk - FM-approved firestop products and accessories
- EZ Trap - Waterless condensate trap systems
- Mini-split mounting solutions - Outdoor brackets and installation hardware
- Surge protection devices - HVAC electrical protection
- PVC primers and cleaners - Low-VOC pipe joining chemicals
- Stainless steel water connectors - Flexible plumbing connections
- Goliath furnace risers - HVAC installation accessories
- RectorSeal Academy - Professional training resources
- FM Approvals 3971 - Fire-rated sealing systems
- Slimduct - Compact lineset cover systems
- HVAC refrigeration linesets - Installation and protection
- Indoor air quality solutions - Filtration and purification

## HVAC Installation & Protection

- [Media Air Cleaners](https://rectorseal.com/hvac/indoor-air-quality/media-air-cleaners): Dust Free Media Air Cleaners for HVAC indoor air quality filtration
- [Outdoor Mounting](https://rectorseal.com/hvac/mini-split/outdoor-mounting): Mini-split outdoor mounting brackets including Big Foot, Slab Stand, Wall Bracket
- [Surge Protection](https://rectorseal.com/hvac/hvac-installation/surge-protection): HVAC surge protectors including RSH-1203P, RSH-20, RSH-50 series devices
- [EZ Trap 600 Series Combo Kit with Clear Trap and Overflow Switch](https://rectorseal.com/ez-trap-600-series-combo-kit-with-clear-trap-and-overflow-switch): EZT626 waterless condensate trap kit with overflow switch for HVAC drainage
- [Goliath Furnace Riser 23" x 7"](https://rectorseal.com/goliath-furnace-riser-23-x-7): Goliath 23"x7" furnace riser kit for HVAC installation clearance
